mentions.name: Snapy
mentions.description: Snapy helps secondhand retail stores digitize and broadcast their live inventory across Google, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, eBay, and more. It has two parts: a mobile app that lets employees snap photos of products to generate and publish listings, and a hardware box that sits inline between the barcode scanner and POS to track in-store sales and automatically remove the corresponding listing when something sells. It is live in 3 stores.
mentions.problem: Secondhand retail stores lack a way to digitize their in-store inventory, keep listings in sync across online marketplaces, and remove listings when items sell in-store.
mentions.audience: Secondhand retail stores and their employees
